text: - Creates a cart automatically if the user does not have one yet.

text: - Checks that the user and product exist before saving an item.

text: - Adds to an existing cart item when the product is already in the cart.
textPreview: - Adds to an existing cart item when the product is already in the cart.

text: - Calculates cart totals from item price multiplied by item quantity.
textPreview: - Calculates cart totals from item price multiplied by item quantity.
